sloka: तं विमोक्षयितुं वीरश्चापमायम्य लक्ष्मणः ।रावणं शक्तिहस्तं वै शरवर्षैरवाकिरत् ।। ६.१०१.२५ ।।
transliteration: taṁ vimokṣayituṁ vīraścāpamāyamya lakṣmaṇaḥ ।rāvaṇaṁ śaktihastaṁ vai śaravarṣairavākirat ।। 6.101.25 ।।

translations.english: Heroic Lakshmana stretched his bow and showered volley of arrows and covered Ravana who held javelin in hand.
